name: wanderers-core
description: Shared library for Foundry VTT modules, vendored and pinned into each module: common code plus an opt-in shared UI stylesheet and helpers (no runtime dependency).

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs src/foundry/*.mjs src/testing/*.mjs tools/*.mjs tests/*.mjs config/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run types && npm test
